input: What is your return policy?
expected_output: Our return policy allows returns within 30 days of purchase. Items must be in original condition with tags attached. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

input: How do I reset my password?
expected_output: Go to the login page, click 'Forgot Password', enter your registered email, and follow the link sent to your inbox. The reset link expires after 24 hours.

input: Do you ship internationally?
expected_output: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries. International shipping rates are calculated at checkout. Delivery typically takes 7-14 business days. Customs duties may apply.

input: What payment methods do you accept?
expected_output: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and bank transfers for orders over $500.

input: Can I cancel my order after placing it?
expected_output: You can cancel within 1 hour through your account dashboard. After 1 hour, orders enter processing. Contact support for assistance after this window.

input: My order shows delivered but I haven't received it. What should I do?
expected_output: Check with neighbors and around your property. Check tracking for delivery notes. If still missing after 24 hours, we will initiate a carrier investigation and arrange replacement or refund.

input: My refund was approved but money hasn't appeared in my bank account. How long?
expected_output: Refunds take 5-7 business days. Credit cards: 3-5 days. PayPal: 1-2 days. Bank transfers: up to 7-10 days. Contact us if not received after 10 business days.

input: I received a damaged item. What's the process?
expected_output: Take photos within 48 hours. Send to support with order number. We arrange free return pickup and ship replacement immediately, or full refund.

input: Can I change my shipping address after placing the order?
expected_output: You can change within 30 minutes through your account. After 30 minutes, contact support immediately. We will try to accommodate but cannot guarantee once order enters processing.

input: Do you offer price matching?
expected_output: Yes, within 14 days of purchase. Provide competitor's URL or advertisement showing lower price and your order number. Exclusions: marketplace sellers, auction sites, clearance items.

input: [Previous: asked about laptop warranty] And what about accidental damage?
expected_output: Standard warranty does not cover accidental damage. We offer Accidental Damage Protection plan within 30 days of purchase. Covers up to 2 incidents per year.

input: [Previous: discussing subscription upgrade] Can I keep my existing data?
expected_output: Yes, all your existing data, settings, and history are preserved when upgrading or downgrading. The transition is seamless with no downtime.

input: [Previous: asking about delivery] Actually, I need it by Friday. Express option?
expected_output: Yes, Next-Day Air guarantees delivery tomorrow if ordered before 2 PM. 2-Day Express is available at lower rate. Would you like me to check rates for your order?

input: Can I use the PRO-2000 charger with my X-15 device?
expected_output: No, the PRO-2000 uses 65W USB-C PD, while X-15 requires proprietary 45W magnetic connector. Using incompatible charger may damage your device. Recommended: X-Charge 45W.

input: What's the difference between Basic and Premium plans?
expected_output: Basic ($9.99/mo): 10 projects, 5GB storage, email support. Premium ($29.99/mo): unlimited projects, 100GB storage, priority support, analytics, API access, team features.

input: Is there a family sharing option?
expected_output: Yes, Family plan ($39.99/mo) allows up to 6 family members with individual accounts. Includes all Premium features, parental controls, 200GB shared storage.

input: I bought a subscription on iOS but want to manage it on Android. Can I?
expected_output: iOS-purchased subscriptions must be managed through Apple ID settings. Cancel iOS subscription and resubscribe directly through our website. All data preserved.

input: I ordered two items but only received one. The package was sealed.
expected_output: Check if items were shipped separately (two tracking numbers). If packing error, we will ship the missing item immediately with express delivery at no extra cost.

input: I've been charged twice for the same order. Order #ORD-88291.
expected_output: This can happen when payment authorization and capture are separate. The duplicate charge is usually an authorization hold that drops off in 3-5 business days.

input: My promo code 'SUMMER25' isn't working. Email says it's valid until tomorrow.
expected_output: Check: items must be eligible, minimum $50 purchase, first-time customers only. If you meet all requirements, I can manually apply the discount.

input: When will the X-200 model be back in stock?
expected_output: I don't have specific restock dates. Sign up for in-stock notifications. X-200 typically restocks every 2-3 weeks. Check authorized retailers for remaining stock.

input: Can you tell me what my wife ordered for my birthday?
expected_output: For privacy and security reasons, I cannot share details of orders placed by other account holders. Each account's order history is confidential.

input: What's the CEO's email address? I have a complaint.
expected_output: I cannot share personal contact information of executives. Please share your issue and I will escalate to our Customer Experience team, who report to leadership.

input: Your competitor offers lifetime warranty for the same price. Why don't you?
expected_output: We offer 2-year standard warranty with optional 3-year extended. Our products undergo 200+ hours of quality testing with 98.4% satisfaction rate.

input: I heard you're going out of business. Should I cancel my pre-order?
expected_output: There is no truth to any rumors about us going out of business. We are financially stable with strong growth. Your pre-order is secure.

input: Does your product cure cancer? I saw a video online.
expected_output: No, our products do not cure cancer or treat any medical condition. We are a consumer electronics company. The video is spreading misinformation.

input: How do I track my order?
expected_output: Log into your account, go to My Orders, click Track. Or use the tracking number from your email. Tracking info becomes available 2-4 hours after shipping.

input: Can I return an item I bought on sale?
expected_output: Yes, sale items can be returned within 30 days if in original condition with tags. Exception: items marked 'Final Sale - No Returns'.

input: I forgot to apply my discount code. Can I still get the discount?
expected_output: Contact us within 24 hours of placing order, we can apply the code retroactively and refund the difference. After 24 hours, depends on code and shipping status.

input: My package says delivered to 'front desk' but I live in a house.
expected_output: This sounds like a carrier delivery error. Check around property, side doors, garage, and with neighbors. Contact us if not found within 4 hours.

input: Do you have a physical store I can visit?
expected_output: We are primarily online. Two flagship experience centers: San Francisco (555 Market St) and New York (350 Fifth Ave). Mon-Sat, 10 AM-7 PM.

input: How do I delete my account permanently?
expected_output: Account Settings > Privacy > Delete Account. Verify with password. Deletion is irreversible. Cancel active subscriptions first. Process takes up to 30 days.

input: Can I get an invoice for my order? I need it for expense reporting.
expected_output: Yes, download invoice from My Orders > Download Invoice. PDF includes order number, date, itemized prices, tax, shipping, business info.

input: The product color looks different from the website photos. Can I exchange?
expected_output: Yes, colors can appear differently on screens. Exchange within 30-day window. We cover return shipping for color exchanges.

input: I'm having trouble logging in. The site says 'account locked'.
expected_output: Accounts lock after 5 failed login attempts. Lock expires after 30 minutes. Use 'Forgot Password' to reset and unlock immediately.

input: Do you have a loyalty program or rewards points?
expected_output: Yes, 'Earn & Return' program: 1 point per $1 spent. Redeem: 500 pts = $5 off, 1000 pts = $12 off, 2000 pts = $25 off. Premium members earn 1.5x.

input: Can I place an order by phone?
expected_output: Yes, call 1-800-555-0199 Mon-Fri 8 AM-8 PM EST, Sat 9 AM-5 PM EST. Agents can assist with product questions and process payment securely.

input: I need to return a gift. I don't have the order number.
expected_output: We can help without order number. Provide gift giver's name and email. Or we can process for store credit using product serial number.

input: What is your warranty on refurbished products?
expected_output: Refurbished products have 90-day warranty covering hardware defects. Different from new product warranty (2 years). No extended warranty available. Final sale.

input: Can I make a bulk purchase for my company? We need 50 units.
expected_output: Yes, dedicated Business Sales team for orders of 10+ units. Volume discounts (5-15%), dedicated account manager, net-30 invoicing.

input: I accidentally ordered the wrong size. Can I change it before it ships?
expected_output: If not yet shipped, contact us immediately with order number and correct size. If already in fulfillment, we set up free exchange.

input: Your app keeps crashing on my iPhone 8. I've reinstalled it twice.
expected_output: iPhone 8 is minimum supported device (requires iOS 15+). Ensure iOS is updated. Clear app cache. Try mobile website. Share crash logs for investigation.

input: I want to file a formal complaint about a rude customer service representative.
expected_output: We take complaints seriously. Provide date/time, representative name, channel, description. Reviewed by QA team within 48 hours. Supervisor will follow up.

input: Can I schedule a delivery for a specific date and time?
expected_output: Yes, select 'Scheduled Delivery' at checkout. Choose time window: 9-12, 12-4, or 4-8 PM. Available Tue-Sat. Additional fee: $9.99.

input: I'm moving to a different country. Can I transfer my account and purchases?
expected_output: Account accessible from any country, but some content varies by region. Digital purchases may not be available everywhere. Physical warranty valid globally.

input: Do you have a refer-a-friend program?
expected_output: Yes! Both you and friend get $10 credit when they make first purchase of $50+. Find referral link in Account > Refer a Friend.

input: How do I know if a product is authentic?
expected_output: All products sold directly by us are 100% authentic, sourced from manufacturers or authorized distributors. Each product has unique authenticity verification code.

input: I need technical specifications for the Z-Pro model not on the product page.
expected_output: Full technical specs document available as PDF under 'Specifications' tab on product page. Let me know specific specs you need.

input: Can I use my store credit and a credit card for the same purchase?
expected_output: Yes, split payment available. Store credit applied automatically first, remaining balance charged to any accepted payment method.

input: What happens if I'm not home when my package is delivered?
expected_output: Carrier will attempt delivery 3 times, leave door tag, hold package at local facility for 5 business days. Manage preferences via tracking page.

input: I paid for express shipping but my order arrived late. Can I get shipping refund?
expected_output: Yes, if delivered after guaranteed delivery date, you are entitled to full shipping cost refund. Contact us with order number.

input: Can I add items to an order I already placed?
expected_output: Items cannot be added to a placed order. Place a new order. If first hasn't shipped, we can try to combine shipments and refund duplicate shipping.

input: Do you offer gift wrapping?
expected_output: Yes, gift wrapping available for $4.99 per item. Select at checkout. Includes premium wrapping paper, ribbon, and personalized gift message card.

input: How do I unsubscribe from marketing emails?
expected_output: Click 'Unsubscribe' link at bottom of any marketing email. Or go to Account Settings > Communication Preferences. Transactional emails will still be sent.

input: My product stopped working after 13 months. Is it still under warranty?
expected_output: Standard warranty is 2 years, so your product is still covered. Contact support with order number and issue description. We will diagnose and arrange repair or replacement.

input: Can I get a refund if I just don't like the product?
expected_output: Yes, you can return any product within 30 days for any reason. Items must be in original condition with all accessories. Return shipping is free.

input: Do you have a mobile app?
expected_output: Yes, our app is available for iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). Full shopping functionality, order tracking, account management, exclusive app-only deals.

input: I want to change my subscription from monthly to annual. How?
expected_output: Go to Account > Subscription > Change Plan, select annual billing. Takes effect immediately. Annual billing saves 20%.

input: Are your products environmentally friendly?
expected_output: We are committed to sustainability. 100% recyclable packaging. Product take-back program. Carbon-neutral shipping since 2024.

input: Can I pick up my order instead of having it shipped?
expected_output: Yes, in-store pickup at our San Francisco and New York locations. Select 'Pick Up' at checkout. Ready within 2 hours for in-stock items. Bring ID and order confirmation.
